如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “楚月姐，这....”楚枫一阵无言。
“这什么这，这不是我给你的，是今年家族的补贴。”楚月一边说着，一边将仙灵草塞入了楚枫的手中。
“若是这样，我就更不能要了，你忘记我还欠你两株仙灵草么。”楚枫将仙灵草推回了回去，说话间又从怀中取出了一株仙灵草。
“楚枫弟，这株仙灵草，你没有炼化？”看着楚枫手中那完整的仙灵草，楚月觉得这肯定是她送楚枫的那株。
“嗯，我早就突破了，所以暂时用不到，正好一同还你。”
“不行，我怎么能收你的仙灵草，这些都是你的，你快收起来。”
“楚月姐，我楚枫说过还你两株，就会还你两株，当初你不也答应了么，如今你这样，让我很为难。”
“可是，我送你的仙灵草你根本就没有用，反而将自己的一同给我，我这不是白白占了你便宜么。”
“楚月姐，你的心意我领了，在整个楚家，除了我父亲和大哥，就属你对我最好，这就当是弟弟孝敬你的成不？”
楚枫是发自肺腑的，在楚家所有人都排挤他的时候，楚月能如此待他，他真心感动。
而见楚枫执意如此，楚月的脸上则是泛起羞愧之色，低声道：
“楚枫弟，你这样真的让我很惭愧，其实...这株仙灵草，并不是我送你的，而是楚孤雨叫我代送给你的。”
“我大哥？”楚枫不由一愣。
楚孤雨，乃是楚渊的亲生子，是楚枫的大哥。
如今正在青州第一宗门“凌云宗”内修炼，年仅十七岁已是灵武六重，是楚家年轻一代的第一人。
楚孤雨，虽知楚枫非楚渊亲生，但却拿楚枫当亲弟弟一般看待，是楚枫最敬爱的人之一。
“他怕你有心里负担，所以才嘱咐我，不能说是他给你的，但是现在，我必须实话实说了。”楚月的脸都红了，可见她真的很惭愧。
“楚月姐，就算如此，我还是要感谢你，不管仙灵草是不是你的，但这些年你对我楚枫的感情是真的，还是那句话，这两株仙灵草，就当是弟弟孝敬你的。”
“何况，你即将步入灵武五重，这仙灵草对你更为重要，你就别推脱了。”楚枫仍毅然的将仙灵草，塞入了楚月手中。
“那这样，仙灵草当是我跟你借的，不过我只借一株，因为我只还的起一株。”见楚枫执意如此，楚月咬了咬牙，只将一株仙灵草收了起来。

其实如楚枫所说，楚月即将迈入灵武五重，如今是关键时期，这仙灵草对她来说，的确很重要。
“成。”楚枫笑了笑。
“对了楚枫弟，孤雨哥还有一封信，要我给你。”楚月又从腰间取出一封信函。
接过信函，楚枫心中一阵感动，他已经五年没有回过楚家，也五年没有见过大哥和父亲，因为他觉得没脸见他们。
可是这五年，他大哥和父亲，几乎每个月都会给他来一封信，可见这两位是多么的想念楚枫。
“好了，信留着回去再看，快跟我进来，今天可是个好日子。”楚月抓住了楚枫的胳膊，拽着他便向府邸内走去。
可还没靠近，楚枫的眉头便微皱起来，他听到府邸内，传来很多熟悉的声音，那些都是他不喜欢的人。
果然，在府邸大门有在青龙宗修炼的楚家人都在场。
至于那几位陌生人，楚枫也能想到他们的来历，一定是楚盟的成员。
“大家快看，谁来了。”楚月开心的呼喊道。
然而当众人齐刷刷的将目光投过来后，楚枫能够感觉到的，却是不屑与厌恶。
“哟，我当是谁呢，这不是我楚家的功臣么。”一名少年向楚枫走了过来。
他叫楚成，是楚真的亲大哥，与楚月一同拜入青龙宗，如今也是灵武四重。
“楚枫，你立功了，知道么？”楚成指着楚枫，目光很是不善。
“楚成，你说什么呢，今天是大喜的日子，别乱说话。”楚月赶忙开口。
“怎么了楚月，他立功了还不让我说？”楚成撇了楚月一眼，而后看向楚枫：“楚枫，你立功了不知道吗？你他妈立大功了。”
“在青龙宗当了五年外门弟子，你把我楚家的脸都丢尽了，如今还有脸来参加楚盟聚会，你的脸皮究竟有多厚?”
“楚成，你给我闭嘴。”楚月有些动怒，然而还不待她多说什么，楚枫却一把拽住了她。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast channel. "Sister Chu Yue, this..." Chu Feng was speechless for a while.
"This, this, this, this is not what I gave you, it is the family's subsidy this year." Chu Yue said as she put the fairy grass into Chu Feng's hand.
"If this is the case, I can't take it anymore. Have you forgotten that I still owe you two fairy grasses?" Chu Feng pushed the fairy grass back, and took out another fairy grass from his arms as he spoke.
"Brother Chu Feng, have you not refined this fairy grass?" Looking at the complete fairy grass in Chu Feng's hand, Chu Yue felt that this must be the one she gave to Chu Feng.
"Well, I broke through a long time ago, so I won't need it for the time being. I just want to return it to you together."
"No, how can I collect your fairy grass? These are all yours, please collect them quickly."
"Sister Chu Yue, I, Chu Feng, said that if I give you two plants, I will give you two plants back. Didn't you agree at the beginning? Now you are like this, which makes me very embarrassed."
"But you didn't use the fairy grass I gave you. Instead, you gave me your own. Didn't I take advantage of you in vain?"
"Sister Chu Yue, I accept your wishes. In the entire Chu family, except for my father and eldest brother, you are the best to me. Do you think this is my brother's filial piety to you?"
Chu Feng spoke from the bottom of his heart. When everyone in the Chu family was ostracizing him, he was truly touched that Chu Yue could treat him like this.
Seeing that Chu Feng insisted on doing this, Chu Yue's face showed a look of shame, and she whispered:
"Brother Chu Feng, I am really ashamed of you for being like this. Actually...this fairy grass was not given to you by me, but by Chu Guyu who asked me to give it to you on your behalf."
"My eldest brother?" Chu Feng couldn't help but be stunned.
Chu Guyu is Chu Yuan's biological son and Chu Feng's eldest brother.
Now he is practicing in the "Lingyun Sect", the first sect in Qingzhou. He is only seventeen years old and has reached the sixth level of Lingwu. He is the leader of the younger generation of the Chu family.
Although Chu Guyu knew that Chu Feng was not Chu Yuan's biological child, he treated Chu Feng as his biological brother and was one of the people Chu Feng respected the most.
"He was afraid that you would be burdened, so he told me not to say that he gave it to you, but now, I have to tell the truth." Chu Yue's face turned red, which showed that she was really ashamed.
"Sister Chu Yue, even so, I still want to thank you. Regardless of whether the fairy grass is yours or not, your feelings for me, Chu Feng, over the years are true. As I said, these two fairy grasses should be treated as filial piety from my younger brother."
"Besides, you are about to enter the fifth level of spiritual martial arts. This fairy grass is more important to you, so don't shirk it." Chu Feng still put the fairy grass into Chu Yue's hands resolutely.
"In that case, I will borrow the fairy grass from you, but I will only borrow one because I can only afford to return one." Seeing that Chu Feng insisted on this, Chu Yue gritted her teeth and collected only one fairy grass.
In fact, as Chu Feng said, Chu Yue is about to enter the fifth level of spiritual martial arts. Now is a critical period. This fairy grass is indeed very important to her.
"Sure." Chu Feng smiled.
"By the way, Brother Chu Feng, Brother Guyu also has a letter that you want me to give to you." Chu Yue took out another letter from her waist.
After receiving the letter, Chu Feng felt moved in his heart. He had not returned to the Chu family for five years, and had not seen his eldest brother and father for five years because he felt ashamed to see them.
But in the past five years, his eldest brother and father have sent him a letter almost every month, which shows how much these two miss Chu Feng.
"Okay, keep the letter and read it when you go back. Come in with me quickly, today is a good day." Chu Yue grabbed Chu Feng's arm, pulled him and walked towards the mansion.
But before he got close, Chu Feng frowned slightly. He heard many familiar voices coming from the mansion, and they were all people he didn't like.
Sure enough, at the gate of the mansion, all the Chu family members who were practicing in Qinglong Sect were present.
As for those strangers, Chu Feng can alsoThinking of their origins, they must be members of the Chu League.
"Everyone, look, who's here." Chu Yue shouted happily.
However, when everyone turned their gazes over, what Chu Feng could feel was disdain and disgust.
"Hey, who do I think he is? Isn't this the hero of my Chu family?" A young man walked towards Chu Feng.
His name is Chu Cheng, he is Chu Zhen's eldest brother. He joined the Qinglong Sect with Chu Yue and is now also at the fourth level of Lingwu.
"Chu Feng, you have made a meritorious service, do you know that?" Chu Cheng pointed at Chu Feng with a very unkind look.
"Chu Cheng, what are you talking about? Today is a happy day, don't talk nonsense." Chu Yue said quickly.
"What's wrong, Chu Yue, he has made a meritorious service and you still don't want me to tell you?" Chu Cheng glanced at Chu Yue, and then looked at Chu Feng: "Chu Feng, don't you know that you have made a meritorious service? You have made a damn great contribution."
"You have been an outer disciple of the Qinglong Sect for five years. You have completely embarrassed our Chu family. Now you still have the nerve to attend the Chu Alliance gathering. How thick-skinned are you?"
"Chu Cheng, shut up." Chu Yue was a little angry, but before she could say anything more, Chu Feng grabbed her.
